description: Form Guide. League table. For requests like "show me the Championship table" or "who is top of La Liga?". Points include official deductions; a deducted club's row has points_deducted.

league.description: One of: premier league, championship, la liga, bundesliga, serie a, ligue 1 (common variants like EPL or German Bundesliga work too). Any other league returns 404. Default premier league.
